standard_prerequisites.name: Mayer-Vietoris for Hom in the derived category: Hom out of a compact-free source can be computed across unions of opens, so a local isomorphism statement propagates from U_0, V_0 and U_0 cap V_0 to U_0 cup V_0
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the gluing step of the local condition P.

standard_prerequisites.name: The induction principle for quasi-compact opens, applied first to opens of S_0 and then to quasi-compact quasi-separated opens of X_0
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the assertion to the affine-affine case.

standard_prerequisites.name: In the affine case the derived-category Hom statement translates into module Hom computations, with K_0 pseudo-coherent and L_0 of finite tor dimension over the ring, by the pseudo-coherence, affine-compare, pseudo-coherent-affine, and tor-dimension lemmas
standard_prerequisites.use: Sets up the hypotheses of the More on Algebra colimit lemma for relatively perfect systems.

core_obligations: Define the condition P for quasi-compact opens U_0 of X_0 and show it is stable under unions by Mayer-Vietoris for Hom: if P holds for U_0, V_0 and U_0 cap V_0 it holds for U_0 cup V_0 (proof lines 9074-9085).

Reduce in two steps with the induction principle: first over quasi-compact opens W_0 of S_0 to the case W_0 affine, hence S_0 affine; then over quasi-compact quasi-separated opens of X_0 to the case X_0 affine (proof lines 9088-9098).

In the affine-affine case translate the statement into module terms: lemma-pseudo-coherent and lemma-affine-compare-bounded convert the Homs to module Homs, lemma-pseudo-coherent-affine shows the module complex of K_0 is pseudo-coherent, and lemma-tor-dimension-rel-affine shows the module complex of L_0 has finite tor dimension; the colimit lemma for relatively perfect systems then gives the isomorphism (proof lines 9101-9115).
proof_roadmap: Set up the local condition P and glue it by Mayer-Vietoris (proof lines 9074-9085).
Reduce to the affine-affine case by two applications of the induction principle (proof lines 9088-9098).
Conclude in the affine case by translating to modules and applying the colimit lemma (proof lines 9101-9115).
